content: Idempotent pipeline = re-running with the same input parameters always yields the same output, no duplicates. Core pattern: pipeline accepts explicit start/end parameters (not implicit 'today'); backfill re-execution uses partition-overwrite (write to a deterministic path/partition keyed by the input params, full overwrite not append) rather than blind INSERT/append, which is what makes re-runs safe. This is the standard, simplest pattern for batch pipelines.
